milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near one of the dead bushes and face toward it to demonstrate they have 'found' it. Target is set to (3,0,3) — the closest dead bush to spawn (~4.2 blocks away). max_distance=16 allows the player to spot it from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it. Multiple dead bushes exist in the scene so the player may find any of them, but this rule targets the nearest one which is most likely to be found first.
